title: BC court rejects couple's claim to a lakeside access road under a 1997 agreement
summary_full: Jeno and Luminita Fabian attempted to assert access rights to their property by using a road on a developer's land. However, the Supreme Court of British Columbia ruled against them regarding the easement agreement from 1997. The court determined that the disputed road section was not covered under that easement. Their alternative request for a statutory easement was also rejected under property law.
